edges.reason: transfer() uses msg.sender as the source of the forwarded transferFrom() call.
transferFrom() reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] and compares msg.sender with _from.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] from the caller address.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender, giving the deployer all privileges.
batchSend() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
delegate() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
init() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress() is guarded by require(msg.sender == owner).
transfer() forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom() calls ensure(), which enforces the owner/tradeAddress/UNI/canSale whitelist.
ensure() falls back to condition(), which returns false for the default zero-configuration state and blocks non-whitelisted sellers.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address for this token.
ensure() compares _from against the hardcoded UNI router constant.
ensure() reads the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
ensure() compares _from and _to against the owner address.
ensure() reads the canSale[_from] whitelist flag.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to cap the number of sales.
condition() compares _value against _minSale.
condition() compares _value against _maxSale.
condition() checks the _saleNum configuration.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executes inside transferFrom() without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executes inside transferFrom() without SafeMath.
balanceOf[_to] += _value executes inside transferFrom() without SafeMath.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ executes inside transferFrom() without SafeMath.
The unchecked allowance subtraction mutates the allowance mapping.

The unchecked addition mutates balanceOf[_to].
Increments the per-address sale counter _onSaleNum.
